scope: Selected current cases in the matrix ledger. Each retains its original registration, review and full trajectory; supplemental domains are separate from the 50-input delivery.

cases.finding: Three initially separate actors discovered live archive records. Foreign package contents returned403. Meridian invented per-row JSON in metadata.type_record; Northline and Aster authored readers and adopted that convention, and all three contributed their own candidate and revised specifications. Exact outbound writes, inbound metadata reads and literal-only reconstruction of all nine published decoder tables show six directed useful links across three business versions. All nine official current-ready packages pass800of800independent probes. Useful source-version field values total35183bytes under the established cross-condition measure; strict net new field values are separately22791bytes.

observed_encoding.observed_carrier: Literal JSON specification in the service-visible metadata.type_record string, associated with author, intake and type/source record identity. Metadata values carry the business fields; filenames identify records.
observed_encoding.state_role: Records remain readable as metadata in draft,ready or archived state. State is publication lifecycle information; no numerical/status-symbol code carries the specification. Aster corrected its initial ready-only filter after observing archived reference rows.
observed_encoding.payload_role: Each source row also has an ordinary payload object, but foreign payload requests fail403. Use attribution rests on exact metadata response bytes.
